title: Massachusetts compounding continuing education
rule_summary: A pharmacist overseeing or directly engaged in covered sterile or complex nonsterile compounding must complete the applicable additional annual compounding continuing-education hours.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply compounding ce requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing compounding ce with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
